name: map-chat
title: Map chat
description: An always-floating chat over a slippy map: the guide answers with tool calls that pan, zoom, pin and route the map (walking times, distances, saved trips). Composed from ArtifactChatContainer and a small tile-map renderer with its own geo maths, places and tool-planning agent; the map navigates on UI SDK's viewport (drag, pinch, scroll and Ctrl/⌘-scroll or pinch to zoom, and on the focused map the arrow keys pan, + and − zoom and 0 returns to the view). Needs network for the map tiles.
